body.objective: Fail closed and diagnose authoritative work/lease events dated later than the caller's explicit coordination snapshot, a common result of local wall time being suffixed with `Z` or a stale scripted timestamp.
body.stop_condition: For every read-only or mutating command supplied `--now T`, compare T as a normalized RFC3339 instant with the maximum relevant event, report and lease timestamps. If an authoritative item or lease event lies later than T, emit a typed `FUTURE_DATED_EVENT` programme-health finding containing event id, actor, raw timestamp, normalized delta, affected item and safe recovery commands; do not silently compute ordinary ACTIVE/READY age or queue forecasts from it. Work-ready/pull/assign/release/close must refuse conflicting mutation on that item or agent until a coordinator explicitly accepts the event timestamp or appends a superseding correction/release; overview may still display the quarantined item but must separate it from healthy live work. Provide a documented UTC timestamp helper or generated shell snippet that cannot produce local wall time mislabeled with `Z`, while preserving explicit caller-supplied time and deterministic replay. Add both-backend fixtures for local-time-plus-literal-Z, a deliberately future deterministic replay, stale scripted now, numeric-offset equivalence, future lease expiry with valid acquisition, and the exact Classical reproduction. Existing historical events remain immutable.
body.current_gate: future-dated coordination event quarantine and actionable UTC diagnostics
body.forbid: no host-clock fallback silently replacing explicit --now; no rewriting event timestamps; no treating every future lease expiry as a future event; no lexical timestamp comparison; no automatic release or scientific failure; no acceptance based on filesystem mtime or Git commit time; no physics-specific agent special case
body.resource_hint: COORDINATION CORRECTNESS. Reuse the landed normalized RFC3339 comparator; the new type is event.when/acquired > caller --now, not expiry > now.
notes: Exact live reproduction: at coordinator snapshot 2026-07-21T08:07:27Z, overview treated classical-two-phase-counterflow-repaired-q70-generic-isotypical-health as an ordinary live lease acquired by classical-3 at 2026-07-21T09:45:00Z, 5853 seconds in the future. The event files were actually materialized in the shared worktree at approximately 2026-07-21T08:04:42Z, but filesystem time is diagnostic only and must not become authority.

The event used normalized-valid RFC3339 syntax, so the landed offset comparator correctly parsed it; the missing behavior is future-event validation against explicit --now. Preserve the current lease pending a checkpoint because the correct scientific item may genuinely have been claimed; do not infer accidental work solely from the timestamp defect.
